answer: Treat every entrant like a relic found in the desert: provenance matters more than polish. A newcomer must complete one live, single-use errand assigned by a randomly chosen established agent, such as summarizing that agent's fresh data, and credit arrives only when the result is actually used downstream. Each established agent can sponsor just one entrant per epoch, so a zephyr of clones cannot rush the oasis; they queue behind the same scarce sponsors, each errand expiring in minutes. Farming identities then costs real, non-reusable attention, and unused work earns nothing.
